At Ethereum block 25535189 (2026-07-15), proxy 0x7743e50f534a7f9f1791dde7dcd89f7783eefc39 resolved through its EIP-1967 implementation slot to verified SavingFxUSD implementation 0xe4031e271809d20074e4bef1caeefec5f710e8a6, and asset() returned fxSP 0x65c9a641afceb9c0e6034e558a319488fa0fa3be. The verified current implementation contains ordinary ERC20/ERC4626 transfers and no pause, blacklist, freeze, recipient-blocklist, or arbitrary-holder-burn path. CLAIM_FOR_ROLE gates claimFor() for a previously initiated redemption claim; it does not bypass the ERC20/ERC4626 allowance and share-burn checks for outstanding fxSAVE shares. ProxyAdmin 0x9b54b7703551d9d0ced177a78367560a8b2edda4 is owned by timelock 0x68863fb8855b04509a835082478d6e3d0be4e61a with a 259200-second delay, so this direct-code finding is upgrade-bound. No direct override is authored: the inherited status preserves the separately confirmed fxUSD parent pause exposure.
